content: BanG Dream! YUME∞MITA revealed the preview for Episode 7 on Tuesday. The episode is slated to release on Thursday, July 30 at 11:00 PM JST. author: Anime Corner

title: Laid-Back Camp, mono Manga Go on Hiatus Due to Creator's Health
content: The editors of both Houbunsha 's Manga Time Kirara magazine and Comic Fuz website announced on Monday that manga creator Afro will go on hiatus due to their health worsening from the stress of serializing two manga at the same time. As a result, the Laid-Back Camp manga and mono manga will both go on hiatus.
author: ANN

title: Immersive Musical Show to Tell Story Set 5 Years After Mamoru Hosoda's Belle Film
content: A website opened on Tuesday to announce Animmersive Live: Ryū to Sobakasu no Hime , an immersive musical show based on Mamoru Hosoda 's BELLE anime film which will run from October 20 to November 15 at MoN Takanawa: The Museum of Narratives in Tokyo.

title: Tengu Tōsen Short Anime Streams on YouTube
content: Tengu Tōsen (Tengu Demon Sword Fight), a short anime project jointly produced by Bandai Namco Entertainment and the IP company Plott , began streaming the first full episode for free on its official YouTube channel last Friday.
author: ANN

title: Guitarist Mei Nekozuki Dies
content: There will be refunds offered for her originally scheduled live events, including her birthday solo live concert on July 29, which have been canceled. Nekozuki was active as a BanG Dream! support guitarist for the millsage and Ikka DumbRock! bands, and she was also active in the C2 Kikan 1MYB band for Kan Colle .
author: ANN

title: Major Crunchyroll Isekai Confirms Sudden Delay for Next New Episode
content: A major Isekai franchise now streaming with Crunchyroll has confirmed a sudden delay before the release of its next new episode this season. Isekai has had a great year of new anime releases so far, and that naturally includes all of the blockbuster franchises that made their return for new episodes as well.
author: ComicBook

title: Crunchyroll to Stream Romelia War Chronicle Anime
content: This year's Otakon event will screen the world premiere on July 31 at 2:45 p.m. EDT. Otakon 2026 is scheduled for July 31-August 2 at the Walter E. Washington Convention Center in Washington, D.C. The series will debut this year. The anime will run for two cours (quarters of a year).
author: ANN
